title: Elementary etale spreading of a geometrically irreducible smooth-fibre open
statement: Let $h:Y\to S$ be a smooth morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] of finite presentation (locally of finite presentation, quasi-compact and quasi-separated) [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $s\in S$ and let $T\subseteq Y_s=Y\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)$ be an open subscheme [def-pc-fibre-product, def-weil-residue-field, def-weil-open-immersion] geometrically irreducible over $\kappa(s)$ [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible]. There exist an affine scheme $S_1$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], an etale morphism $a:S_1\to S$ [def-weil-etale-morphism], a point $s_1\in S_1$ with $a(s_1)=s$ inducing an isomorphism $\kappa(s)\to\kappa(s_1)$, and a quasi-compact open subscheme $V\subseteq Y\times_S S_1$, such that every fibre of $V\to S_1$ is geometrically integral and $V_{s_1}=T\times_{\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)}\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s_1)$ as open subschemes of $(Y\times_S S_1)_{s_1}$. Geometrically integral has the meaning of [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible, def-pc-integral-scheme].

source.place: Tag 057J, lemma-normal-morphism-irreducible, specialized to a smooth morphism using Tag 056W, lemma-smooth-normal; exactly the application in Tag 057K.

proof.text: By [lem-pc-smooth-flat], $h$ is flat, and by [sbc-lem-smooth-geometrically-reduced] all its fibres are geometrically reduced. Its finite presentation is a hypothesis. Moreover $T$ is geometrically connected: for every field extension $L/\kappa(s)$, $T_L$ is nonempty and irreducible by [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible, def-weil-irreducible-components]. If $T_L$ were partitioned into two nonempty clopen subsets, these would be two proper closed subsets covering it, contradicting irreducibility. This is exactly connectedness in [def-weil-connected-scheme]. Thus the flatness, finite-presentation, geometric-reducedness and geometric-connectedness hypotheses needed for the next step all hold.

source.place: Tag 057J, proof, first application of Tag 055W; smooth specialization as in Tag 057K

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-geometrically-connected-fibre-open-spreading] to $h,s,T$. It supplies an affine elementary etale neighbourhood $(S_1,s_1)\to(S,s)$ and a quasi-compact open $V\subseteq Y\times_S S_1$ whose fibres are geometrically connected, with $V_{s_1}=T\times_{\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)}\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s_1)$ as open subschemes of the designated fibre. In particular the residue-field map at $s_1$ is an isomorphism. Retain this neighbourhood and this entire open; it remains to prove geometric integrality of its fibres.

source.place: Tag 057J, proof, first sentence; Tag 055W, label lemma-fibre-geometrically-connected-reduced

proof.text: The projection $Y\times_S S_1\to S_1$ is smooth by clause (2) of [lem-pc-proper-base-change], applied to $h$ and $a$. The inclusion of $V$ is an open immersion, so [lem-pc-open-immersion-smooth-composition] shows that $v:V\to S_1$ is smooth. This uses no separatedness or Noetherian hypothesis on $S$ or $S_1$.

source.place: Tag 057J, proof, sentence about the open of the base change; Morphisms Tags 01VB, 01VC and 01VA

proof.text: Fix $t\in S_1$ and an arbitrary field extension $K/\kappa(t)$. Put $C=V_t\times_{\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(t)}\operatorname{Spec}K$. By [def-pc-base-change] this is the base change of $v$ to $\operatorname{Spec}K$, so its structure map $c:C\to\operatorname{Spec}K$ is smooth by clause (2) of [lem-pc-proper-base-change]. For every further extension $L/K$, the iterated-base-change identification of [def-pc-base-change] identifies $C_L$ with $(V_t)_L$. The latter is connected by step 2 and [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible]. Hence $c$ has geometrically connected fibres (the base has just one point) and $C$ is nonempty, using [def-weil-connected-scheme]. To check the base hypotheses of the next step, [lem-weil-pbc-spec-domain-stalks-function-field] applied to the domain $K$ shows that $\operatorname{Spec}K$ is integral, its function field is $K$, and its only local ring is $K_{(0)}=K$. A field is integrally closed in its own fraction field, since every element of that fraction field already lies in the field. The one-point and residue-field description is also explicit in [def-weil-affine-spectrum].

source.place: Tag 057J, proof, final paragraph, applied after an arbitrary residue-field extension; Varieties Tag 056T and Properties Tag 033M

proof.text: Apply [lem-sbc-smooth-connected-generic-geometry-core] with base $\operatorname{Spec}K$ and structure map $c$. For its generic-fibre datum use the cartesian identity base change $C\times_{\operatorname{Spec}K}\operatorname{Spec}K\cong C$, as in [def-pc-base-change]; the base function field and all remaining hypotheses were checked in step 4. Its conclusion that $C$ is integral is exactly what is needed. Because $t$ and $K/\kappa(t)$ were arbitrary, [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible] says that every fibre $V_t$ is geometrically integral. The affine etale neighbourhood, residue-field isomorphism, quasi-compactness and exact equality of the prescribed open fibre remain those supplied in step 2, proving every clause.
